ctx.x: Yeah, Pee Wee Hunt had a whole bunch of hit records back in what had to be, what, 1949, 50, somewhere? Yeah, 48. He had a pretty big record on High Society. Really? Yeah. And South, 12th Street Rag, a song called O, O-H.
